59940-rhymes-of-the-survey-and-frontier.title: and Frontier
59940-rhymes-of-the-survey-and-frontier.creator: Unknown
59940-rhymes-of-the-survey-and-frontier.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Many will follow, but you must lead  The way o'er the ancient clay,   Paying the price of a nation's need;  Comrades you leave by the way. Yet in the future you see a land  Peopled and loved as a home;   Men who will listen and understand  Your work in the great alone.

arxiv-1707-08925.title: Inductive and Functional Types in Ludics Extended version of the paper accepted for publication in CSL 2017.
arxiv-1707-08925.creator: Alice Pavaux
arxiv-1707-08925.description: Abstract Ludics is a logical framework in which types/formulas are modelled by sets of terms with the same computational behaviour. This paper investigates the representation of inductive data types and functional types in ludics. We study their structure following a game semantics approach.

arxiv-2004-14626.title: Rethinking Coherence Modeling: Synthetic vs. Downstream Tasks
arxiv-2004-14626.creator: Tasnim Mohiuddin, Prathyusha Jwalapuram, Xiang Lin, Shafiq Joty
arxiv-2004-14626.description: Abstract Although coherence modeling has come a long way in developing novel models, their evaluation on downstream applications for which they are purportedly developed has largely been neglected. With the advancements made by neural approaches in applications such as machine translation (MT), summarization and dialog systems, the need for coherence evaluation of these tasks is now more crucial than ever.

arxiv-2006-00016.title: Quantum Circuits for Sparse Isometries
arxiv-2006-00016.creator: Emanuel Malvetti, Raban Iten, Roger Colbeck
arxiv-2006-00016.description: Abstract We consider the task of breaking down a quantum computation given as an isometry into C-not s and single-qubit gates, while keeping the number of C-not gates small. Although several decompositions are known for general isometries, here we focus on a method based on Householder reflections that adapts well in the case of sparse isometries.

arxiv-2107-00500.title: On the detection-to-track association for online multi-object tracking Journal: Pattern Recognition Letters
arxiv-2107-00500.creator: Xufeng Lin, Chang-Tsun Li, Victor Sanchez, Carsten Maple
arxiv-2107-00500.description: Abstract Driven by recent advances in object detection with deep neural networks, the tracking-by-detection paradigm has gained increasing prevalence in the research community of multi-object tracking (MOT). It has long been known that appearance information plays an essential role in the detection-to-track association, which lies at the core of the tracking-by-detection paradigm.

arxiv-2111-07849.title: Near Optimal VNF Placement in Edge-Enabled 6G Networks This work has been partially funded by the EC H2020 5Growth Project (grant no. 856709). The work by Carlos Ruiz de Mendoza was done while carrying out the Master Thesis at CTTC.
arxiv-2111-07849.creator: Carlos Ruiz De Mendoza, Bahador Bakhshi, Engin Zeydan, Josep Mangues-Bafalluy
arxiv-2111-07849.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Carlos Ruiz De Mendoza, Bahador Bakhshi, Engin Zeydan, Josep Mangues-Bafalluy. Softwarization and virtualization are key concepts for emerging industries that require ultra-low latency. This is only possible if computing resources, traditionally centralized at the core of communication networks, are moved closer to the user, to the network edge. However, the realization of Edge Computing (EC) in the sixth generation (6G) of mobile networks requires efficient resource allocation mechanisms for the placement of the Virtual Network Functions (VNFs).

arxiv-2112-15188.title: Towards Robustness of Neural Networks
arxiv-2112-15188.creator: Steven Basart
arxiv-2112-15188.description: Abstract We introduce several new datasets namely ImageNet-A/O and ImageNet-R as well as a synthetic environment and testing suite we called CAOS. ImageNet-A/O allow researchers to focus in on the blind spots remaining in ImageNet. ImageNet-R was specifically created with the intention of tracking robust representation as the representations are no longer simply natural but include artistic, and other renditions.

arxiv-2206-10389.title: Parameterized-NL Completeness of Combinatorial Problems by Short Logarithmic-Space Reductions and Immediate Consequences of the Linear Space Hypothesis 1 1 1 A conference version will appear in the Proceedings of the Future Technologies Conference (FTC 2022), October 2022.
arxiv-2206-10389.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by . The concept of space-bounded computability has become significantly important in handling vast data sets on memory-limited computing devices. To replenish the existing short list of NL-complete problems whose instance sizes are dictated by log-space size parameters, we propose new additions obtained directly from natural parameterizations of three typical NP-complete problems—the vertex cover problem, the exact cover by 3-sets problem, and the 3-dimensional matching problem.

arxiv-2210-02783.title: Topological modes in stellar oscillations
arxiv-2210-02783.creator: Armand Leclerc, Guillaume Laibe, Pierre Delplace, Antoine Venaille, Nicolas Perez
arxiv-2210-02783.description: Abstract Stellar oscillations can be of topological origin. We reveal this deep and so-far hidden property of stars by establishing a novel parallel between stars and topological insulators. We construct an hermitian problem to derive the expression of the stellar acoustic-buoyant frequency S S of non-radial adiabatic pulsations.

arxiv-2210-03335.title: A Keypoint Based Enhancement Method for Audio Driven Free View Talking Head Synthesis
arxiv-2210-03335.creator: Yichen Han, Ya Li, Yingming Gao, Jinlong Xue, Songpo Wang, Lei Yang
arxiv-2210-03335.description: Abstract Audio driven talking head synthesis is a challenging task that attracts increasing attention in recent years. Although existing methods based on 2D landmarks or 3D face models can synthesize accurate lip synchronization and rhythmic head pose for arbitrary identity, they still have limitations, such as the cut feeling in the mouth mapping and the lack of skin highlights.

arxiv-2410-01991.title: Whittaker–Shintani functions for Fourier–Jacobi models on unitary groups
arxiv-2410-01991.creator: Paul Boisseau
arxiv-2410-01991.description: Abstract We state and prove a formula for the Whittaker–Shintani functions associated to Fourier–Jacobi models for p p -adic unitary groups and general linear groups. These generalized spherical functions play a fundamental role in the proof of the Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for Fourier–Jacobi models. As an application we prove the unramified Ichino–Ikeda conjecture. 1 Introduction 1.

arxiv-2411-13614.title: Verification and Validation of Autonomous Systems
arxiv-2411-13614.creator: 1 st Sneha Sudhir Shetiya, 2 nd Vikas Vyas, 3 th Shreyas Renukuntla
arxiv-2411-13614.description: Abstract This paper describes how to proficiently prevent software defects in autonomous vehicles, discover and correct defects if they are encountered, and create a higher level of assurance in the software product development phase. It also describes how to ensure high assurance on software reliability. I Introduction In today’s world software is pervasive. Software helps make life convenient.

arxiv-2501-08425.title: Is Stochastic Gradient Descent Effective? A PDE Perspective on Machine Learning processes
arxiv-2501-08425.creator: Davide Barbieri, Matteo Bonforte, Peio Ibarrondo
arxiv-2501-08425.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Davide Barbieri, Matteo Bonforte, Peio Ibarrondo. In this paper we analyze the behaviour of the stochastic gradient descent (SGD), a widely used method in supervised learning for optimizing neural network weights via a minimization of non-convex loss functions. Since the pioneering work of Li, Tai and E (2017), the underlying structure of such processes can be understood via parabolic PDEs of Fokker-Planck type, which are at the core of our analysis.

arxiv-2501-13902.title: Secure Quantum Key Distribution Using a Room-Temperature Quantum Emitter
arxiv-2501-13902.creator: Ömer S. Tapşın, Furkan Ağlarcı, Roberto G. Pousa, Daniel K. L. Oi, Mustafa Gündoğan, Serkan Ateş
arxiv-2501-13902.description: Abstract On-demand generation of single photons from solid-state quantum emitters is essential to build practical quantum networks and QKD systems by potentially enabling higher secure key rates (SKR) and lower quantum bit error rates (QBER) in short-range distances. Room-temperature operation is particularly important as it eliminates the need for bulky cryogenic setups, reducing complexity and cost for real-world applications.

arxiv-2501-17087.title: Multiscale simulations of three-dimensional nanotube networks: Enhanced modeling using unit cells Journal: Computational Materials Science
arxiv-2501-17087.creator: Fabian Gumpert, Dominik Eitel, Olaf Kottas, Uta Helbig, Jan Lohbreier
arxiv-2501-17087.description: Abstract This study presents a simulation approach for three-dimensional nanotube networks using cubic and tetragonal unit cells to enhance modeling efficiency. A random-walk algorithm was developed to generate these networks, which were analyzed in a Finite Element Method (FEM) simulation to assess their electrical conductivity.

arxiv-2504-03999.title: Automated Polarization Rotation for Multi-Axis Rotational-Anisotropy Second Harmonic Generation Experiments
arxiv-2504-03999.creator: Karna A. Morey*, Bryan T. Fichera*, Baiqing Lv, Zonqi Shen, Nuh Gedik †
arxiv-2504-03999.description: Abstract Rotational anisotropy second harmonic generation (RA-SHG) is a nonlinear optical technique used to probe the symmetry of condensed matter systems. Measuring the dependence of the SHG susceptibility on one or more external parameters, notably strain, field, temperature, or time delay, is an extremely powerful way to probe complex phases of quantum materials.

pmc-11510624.title: Predicting the Release Mechanism of Amorphous Solid Dispersions: A Combination of Thermodynamic Modeling and In Silico Molecular Simulation
pmc-11510624.creator: Stefanie Walter, Paulo G M Mileo, Mohammad Atif Faiz Afzal, Samuel O Kyeremateng, Matthias Degenhardt, Andrea R Browning, John C Shelley, Duncan Craig
pmc-11510624.description: Background: During the dissolution of amorphous solid dispersion (ASD) formulations, the drug load (DL) often impacts the release mechanism and the occurrence of loss of release (LoR). The ASD/water interfacial gel layer and its specific phase behavior in connection with DL strongly dictate the release mechanism and LoR of ASDs, as reported in the literature.

pmc-11626664.title: Diagnostic Accuracy of Hemoglobin Levels and Red Blood Cell Parameters for Iron Deficiency in Adolescents: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11626664.creator: Walaa M Alsafi, Ahmed A Gaffer, Abdullah Al-Nafeesah, Ashwaq AlEed, Jaber Alfaifi, Ishag Adam
pmc-11626664.description: Objective. To assess the performance of hemoglobin level and red blood cell parameters (mean corpuscular volume [MCV], mean corpuscular hemoglobin [MCH], mean corpuscular hemoglobin concentration [MCHC], and red blood cell distribution width [RDW]) in the diagnosis of iron deficiency among adolescents in eastern Sudan. Methods. A cross-sectional study. Results. Of 374 adolescents. The median age was 14.1 years.

pmc-12399815.title: Discectomy with spinal anesthesia in the third trimester of pregnancy: A case report and literature review
pmc-12399815.creator: Ali Mehrafshan, Parisa Hajilo, Fateme Samiee
pmc-12399815.description: Low back pain is common during pregnancy, but symptomatic lumbar disc herniation in this period is particularly rare. We report a case of lumbar disc herniation in a 35-year-old woman at 32 weeks of pregnancy, who experienced persistent symptoms despite 6 weeks of rest and medication.

pmc-12465761.title: Management of retroperitoneal perforated descending duodenal diverticulum using de pezzer catheter drainage combined with nutritional jejunostomy: a case report and review of the literature
pmc-12465761.creator: Limin Guo, Shuk Ying WONG, Dongdong Zhang, Lei Guo, Simin Chen, Peng Guo
pmc-12465761.description: IntroductionDuodenal diverticulum (DD) ranks as the second most prevalent form of intestinal diverticulum and is typically asymptomatic. However, perforations of DD, while rare, are associated with potentially fatal outcomes.Presentation of caseA 78-year-old Chinese male patient presented with epigastric pain after overeating the day before admission.

pmc-12501409.title: Efficacy of Disitamab Vedotin and Immune Profiles in High‐Risk Non‐Muscle‐Invasive Bladder Cancer With HER2 Overexpression
pmc-12501409.creator: Haoyang Liu, Junru Chen, Qiyu Zhu, Haolin Liu, Yeechun Chuang, Mengni Zhang, Guangxi Sun, Hao Zeng
pmc-12501409.description: ar recurrence and progression rates still reach 58% and 35%, respectively, among HR‐NMIBC patients receiving BCG [1]. Patients with HR‐NMIBC and HER2 overexpression exhibited a higher risk of disease recurrence and progression following BCG treatment [1].

pmc-12566868.title: Predictive Value of Baseline Left Ventricular Global Longitudinal Strain for Cardiac Dysfunction in Patients with Moderate to High Risk of Cancer Therapy-Related Cardiovascular Toxicity
pmc-12566868.creator: Anna Borowiec, Patrycja Ozdowska, Magdalena Rosinska, Agnieszka Maria Zebrowska, Slawomir Jasek, Beata Kotowicz, Hanna Kosela-Paterczyk, Elzbieta Lampka, Zbigniew Nowecki, Jan Walewski
pmc-12566868.description: Background: Anthracycline-based chemotherapy is associated with a risk of cancer therapy-related cardiac dysfunction (CTRCD), particularly in patients with moderate to high cardiovascular risk. Left ventricular global longitudinal strain (GLS) is a sensitive marker for early myocardial dysfunction, but the prognostic value of baseline GLS in this population remains unclear.

pmc-12590753.title: Sexual behaviors and self-reported sexually transmitted infections (STIs) among male and female youths in Nigeria
pmc-12590753.creator: David Aduragbemi Okunlola, Oluwatobi Abel Alawode, Chioma Veronica Opara, Anthony Idowu Ajayi
pmc-12590753.description: BackgroundSexually transmitted infections (STIs) remain a global public health issue and are highly prevalent in sub-Saharan Africa, with current literature indicating that risky sexual behaviors are major risk factors. Studies have shown that STIs are more common among young people engaging in risky sexual behaviors.

pmc-12593042.title: Investigation of Aggregation-Induced Emission Mechanism of a Styrene Derivative: A Theoretical Unraveling of S1/S0‑Conical Intersection
pmc-12593042.creator: Aarzoo, Ram Kinkar Roy
pmc-12593042.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The mechanisms behind the fluorescence quenching of the styrene derivative, 4-dimethylamino-2-benzylidene malonic acid dimethyl ester (BIM) in solution are investigated computationally in the present study. Utilizing a penalty-constrained search algorithm of geometry optimization along with spin-flip long-range corrected time-dependent density functional theory (SF-LC-TDDFT), we examined the energetic and structural changes of the BIM molecule at the minimum energy conical intersection (MECI) between S1 and S0 states.

pmc-12616567.title: Mandatory linking of penicillin allergy “safety alert” with beta-lactam medication history: correcting the automated inaccuracy of penicillin allergy labeling and beta-lactam antibiotic avoidance
pmc-12616567.creator: Richard Neal Olans, David J. Witt, Ruchit Marfatia, Rita Drummond Olans
pmc-12616567.description: ing over 30 million patients who would be predicted to tolerate penicillin or other beta-lactam antibiotics. 1,2 The seemingly innocuous substitution of non-beta-lactam antibiotics for beta-lactams has repeatedly been associated with inferior and even fatal outcomes and promotes antibiotic resistance. 1 Underlying causes of this epidemic are multifactorial and have been described at length.

pmc-12634291.title: Patient centered comparative evaluation of injectable platelet concentrate with or without micro-needling in the management of thin gingival phenotype: A randomized clinical trial
pmc-12634291.creator: Anisha Singh, Chetan Chandra, Vivek Kumar Bains, Anil Kumar Jha, Ruchi Srivastava, Sunakshi Soi
pmc-12634291.description: AimTo evaluate the clinical and patient-centered outcomes of Injectable Platelet Concentrate (IPC) and Microneedling (MN) in augmenting thin gingival phenotype (GP).Materials and methodsThe present study was a patient-centered, split-mouth, randomized clinical trial involving 26 participants with thin GP who were randomly treated with IPC + MN (Group 1) and IPC-MN (Group 2).

pmc-12715073.title: In silico-driven protocol for hit-to-lead optimization: a case study on PDE9A inhibitors
pmc-12715073.creator: Hiroyuki Ogawa, Masateru Ohta, Mitsunori Ikeguchi
pmc-12715073.description: Hit-to-lead (H2L) optimization is a critical stage in small-molecule drug discovery, where efficient exploration of chemical space is required to identify promising lead compounds. Conventional H2L workflows rely on iterative synthesis and experimental evaluation, which limit the range of chemical space that can be explored.

pmc-12849327.title: Explainable deep learning ensemble framework for accurate classification of wild poisonous mushroom species
pmc-12849327.creator: Aras Fahrettin Korkmaz, Fatih Ekinci, Eda Kumru, Abdullah Aydoğan, Hasna Sena Kaymak, Mustafa Sevindik, Mehmet Serdar Güzel, Ilgaz Akata
pmc-12849327.description: This study introduces an explainable deep learning framework for the accurate classification of wild poisonous mushroom species, contributing to food safety. A balanced dataset of 3600 high-resolution images representing 18 species was employed, split into training, validation, and test subsets.

pmc-13233422.title: Associations between psychosocial distress and health-promoting lifestyles in patients with malignant tumors: the critical role of self-perceived burden
pmc-13233422.creator: Dengcui Zhao, Xiaoqian Shen, Miaomiao Zhang, Xiuli Li, Cong Wang, Lei Nie
pmc-13233422.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundAs cancer survivorship rates improve, the focus of oncological care has shifted toward enhancing long-term quality of life through health-promoting lifestyles (HPL). However, the adoption of such behaviors is often hindered by complex psychosocial barriers.

pmc-13404754.title: Development of a Vocabulary Inventory for English-Mandarin Dual-Language-Learning Infants and Toddlers
pmc-13404754.creator: Kristy H. Lai, Huanhuan Shi, Yueting Pan, Catherine S. Tamis-LeMonda
pmc-13404754.description: The science of early bilingual language development requires accurate documentation of the words that infants/toddlers acquire in each language to address questions about language transfer, mutual exclusivity, conceptual vocabulary growth, etc. We developed the Dual Language Learners English–Mandarin (DLL-EM) inventories to measure the vocabularies of English–Mandarin infants/toddlers.

pmc-13413080.title: Patient-Level Multidimensional Response Phenotypes in Obesity-Associated Type 2 Diabetes: A 12-Month Real-World Cohort Study
pmc-13413080.creator: Ioana Bujdei-Tebeică, Anca Mihaela Pantea-Stoian, Doina Andrada Mihai, Simona Diana Ștefan, Cristian Serafinceanu
pmc-13413080.description: Background/Objectives: Type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) has been evaluated through a glucocentric model centered on hyperglycemia, glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c) targets, and complications. However, obesity-associated T2DM reflects a broader metabolic ecosystem in which glycemic control interacts with adiposity, inflammation, muscle function, renal stability, and treatment mechanisms.

pmc-13443535.title: A federated learning–enabled energy-aware anomaly detection algorithm for secure big data analytics in IoT-based smart healthcare systems
pmc-13443535.creator: Halah Abdulaziz Al-Alshaikh
pmc-13443535.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The rapid expansion of Internet of Things (IoT) devices in smart healthcare systems has led to the generation of large volumes of diverse medical data. This creates challenges in ensuring secure, scalable, and energy-efficient anomaly detection. Traditional centralized deep learning methods rely on continuously sending sensitive patient data to cloud servers, which increases communication overhead, consumes more energy, and raises privacy concerns.
